description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class 'MyInfoAPI' within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It provides functionality to retrieve the logged-in employee's personal details in various formats (default, summarized, detailed) via a REST API. The class uses traits for authentication and employee services, includes API documentation annotations, and overrides endpoint methods for fetching data, validation, and unimplemented methods for update and delete operations.

classes.name: MyInfoAPI
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint for retrieving personal employee information of the logged-in user, supporting different data models and integrating with OrangeHRM's core API infrastructure.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the current employee's details in the specified model format, throwing an exception if the employee record is not found.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getOne' API method, including optional 'model' parameter validation.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Determines and returns the class of the data model to be used based on the 'model' query parameter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Unimplemented method for updating employee data, throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'update' method, currently unimplemented.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Unimplemented method for deleting data, throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'delete' method, currently unimplemented.
